title.zh: 武汉英才奖学金 · 一等

summary.zh: 研究领域为组合数学与图论，关注图与超图的极值问题、子图计数与熵方法。
summary.en: Research in combinatorics and graph theory, focusing on extremal graphs and hypergraphs, subgraph counting, and entropy methods.

title.en: Extremal graph theory and subgraph counting

description.zh: 研究广义 Turán 问题，以及有界匹配数和禁用路、圈条件下的计数与极值结构。
description.en: Generalized Turán problems, counting, and extremal structures under bounds on matching number and restrictions on paths and cycles.

description.zh: 研究 Berge 超图中的禁用结构与极值问题，包括 Berge 匹配的 Turán 数。
description.en: Forbidden structures and extremal problems in Berge hypergraphs, including Turán numbers of Berge matchings.

title.zh: 熵方法与诱导子图计数
title.en: Entropy methods and induced subgraph counts

description.zh: 利用熵方法研究给定边数下的诱导子图计数，以及路与圈的相关上界。
description.en: Entropy methods for induced subgraph counts in graphs with a prescribed number of edges, including bounds for paths and cycles.

title.zh: scButterfly：单细胞跨模态转换研究

details.zh: Nature Communications 论文第二作者，参与结果分析。
details.en: Second author of the Nature Communications publication; participated in results analysis.

title.zh: 熵方法与诱导子图计数研究
title.en: Entropy methods for induced subgraph counting

details.zh: 合作研究给定边数下的诱导子图计数，利用熵方法给出路与圈的相关上界。
details.en: Collaborative research on induced subgraph counts in graphs with a prescribed number of edges, using entropy to obtain bounds for paths and cycles.

summary.zh: 清华大学数学系博士研究生。研究领域为组合数学与图论，关注极值问题、子图计数和熵方法。曾赴 Alfréd Rényi 数学研究所开展为期一年的研究交流。
summary.en: PhD student in mathematical sciences at Tsinghua University. Research interests include combinatorics, graph theory, extremal problems, subgraph counting, and entropy methods. Completed a one-year research visit at the Alfréd Rényi Institute of Mathematics.

objective.zh: 大模型算法研究实习 / Research Scientist 实习
objective.en: LLM algorithm research / Research Scientist internship

summary.zh: 清华大学数学系博士研究生，申请大模型算法研究实习。研究背景包括组合数学、图论与熵方法；曾作为 scButterfly 论文第二作者参与结果分析。
summary.en: PhD student in mathematical sciences at Tsinghua University seeking an LLM algorithm research internship. Research background in combinatorics, graph theory, and entropy methods; second author of scButterfly, with a contribution to results analysis.

aboutFirst.zh: 我是清华大学数学系博士研究生，导师为陆玫教授。本科就读于南开大学，研究方向为组合数学与图论。
aboutFirst.en: I am a PhD student in the Department of Mathematical Sciences at Tsinghua University, advised by Professor Mei Lu. Before joining Tsinghua, I studied at Nankai University.

aboutSecond.zh: 我曾获国家留学基金委资助，赴匈牙利布达佩斯 Alfréd Rényi 数学研究所进行为期一年的交流，与 Ervin Győri 和 Dániel Gerbner 开展研究合作。
aboutSecond.en: My research centers on combinatorics and graph theory. I visited the Alfréd Rényi Institute of Mathematics in Budapest for one year with support from the China Scholarship Council, working with Ervin Győri and Dániel Gerbner.
